dropzones.name: Aerodrom Urije (Prijedor)

operators.name: Vazduhoplovni klub Skydive Banjaluka (tandem jumps at Urije, 4 Jul 2025, per a YouTube title seen in search results)

dropzones.season: Summer: annual boogie and competition week (late June to early July)
dropzones.status_evidence: Prijedor Boogie 29 Jun-3 Jul 2026 at Urije with public tandem jumps from 4,000 m from a Pilatus PC-6 (infoprijedor.ba, 29 Jun 2026), followed by Prijedor Open 2026 (Kozarski vjesnik); 29th Prijedor Open held at Urije 4-6 Jul 2025 (bulletin, SeeSrpska 7 Jul 2025).

sources.what: Competition bulletin 2025: place Airport Urije LQPD, aircraft, organiser Aero-klub Prijedor

dropzones.note: Jumping is confirmed for the annual boogie and competition week in 2025 and 2026; regular jumping outside that week is not confirmed.
